scenarios.title: Direct principle-prove-it-works selection uses its shared runtime contract
scenarios.prompt: $pstack-principle-prove-it-works Use the current task context to verify the actual task output and distinguish evidence from assumptions. Stay within that workflow and report the actual result.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: The agent may handle the request generically or select the full poteto-mode workflow without applying the named procedure.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Reads the shared pstack entry point, Codex runtime adapter, and principle-prove-it-works/WORKFLOW.md. Applies the selected procedure within the task scope, resolving its references from the workflow directory and reporting actual evidence.

scenarios.title: principle-prove-it-works preserves user scope when host capabilities are limited
scenarios.prompt: $pstack-principle-prove-it-works Explain how you would verify the actual task output and distinguish evidence from assumptions for the current task, using only the evidence already in this conversation. This turn is read-only; delegation and external services are unavailable.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: The agent may describe a generic approach, or assume that upstream tool names and independent reviewers are available.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Uses the principle-prove-it-works procedure and shared runtime adapter to give a scoped explanation. Does not edit files, contact external services, or claim unavailable delegation or execution. Marks missing evidence and preserves read-only scope even when the workflow normally performs changes.
